div.div: 4 اخرسهُ ٱللّٰهُ [God made him to be dumb: see خَرِسَ]: (S:) God made him to be tonguetied, or speechless, (A, K,) either from inability to find words to express what he would say, or by natural conformation [of the organs of speech]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
